data.name: PlugIn_Description
data.value: Locks the content of the releases which aren't released yet: maps, item drops, NPCs, classes, quests, mini games and features. The releases are changed through the API (api/releases).

data.name: MapLocked
data.value: This map isn't available yet. It arrives with a coming release.

data.name: DropLogPlugIn_Description
data.value: Logs the items which killed monsters drop and the drops blocked by the content releases, to verify the locks in the game.
